incident-bot: [ALERT] 1752104320 - Elevated SSE disconnect rate for /v1/stream with function-calling. 30% of streams returned 1006 within last 5m. Paging Kai (oncall). See /incidents/1752104321 for thread.

Kai (oncall): On it. paging Alex and Jordan. Initial ask: are we seeing client-side errors or server-initiated closes?

Alex (sre): Looking at ingress LB logs now. I'm seeing a spike in backend 502/connection reset around 1752104250-1752104350 correlated w/ the alert window.

Jordan (mlinfra): I can tail runtime logs for the model router and tool-call parser. Starting: `ssh runtime-1 && sudo journalctl -fu redwood-runtime`

Maya (eng-runtime): FYI app router reports increased latency on function-call paths. Hypothesis: KV cache eviction + long compilation spikes causing rtt to exceed client's keepalive, leading to SSE termination.

Olivia (prod-support): Sara, any customer reports? We have one enterprise customer (AcmeCorp) ticketing that the assistant cut off mid-tool call. Ticket ID: 4237. They reported repeated partial tool outputs.

Sara (customer-success): Confirmed. Customer saw partial JSON from tool responses, then the session stop. They have server retry logic that fails on malformed tool-call payloads. Customer impact: failed tool triggers in 12% of their sessions during window.

Alex (sre): Captured sample correlation IDs from LB: `cid: a3f9b2c2`, `cid: a3f9b2d7`. Pulling detailed traces.

Alex (sre): Paste of runtime snippet around cid a3f9b2c2:
```
2025-08-17T12:05:42Z [INFO] conn=789 start stream client=10.2.1.9 path=/v1/stream
2025-08-17T12:05:43Z [WARN] conn=789 tool-call parse error: unexpected EOF while parsing value
2025-08-17T12:05:43Z [INFO] conn=789 stream closed code=1006 remote-close
```

Jordan (mlinfra): Got a matching trace in the function-caller component. It logs: `write_frame_to_client failed: broken pipe` right before the parse error. Looks like partial frames delivered.

Maya (eng-runtime): Can someone confirm if the SSE framing buffer is honouring backpressure? We had a prior fix for chunk flushing that might be regressing under high compile latency.

Alex (sre): Running a quick check: enacted mitigation 1: increase upstream keepalive from 30s -> 90s for the affected route. Command: `kubectl patch svc router --patch '{"spec":{"sessionAffinity":"ClientIP"}}'` (note: not exactly keepalive, this is a placeholder; actual flag changed in envoy config). Pushing proxy config now.

Kai (oncall): Noted. Apply mitigations that don't risk major failover. Also enable extra logging: `env LOG_FRAME_DROPS=1` on router pods.

Olivia (prod-support): Notifying AcmeCorp that we're investigating and applied temporary keepalive bump. Asked for any client logs and if they can reproduce with curl.

Sara (customer-success): Customer sent a curl reproduction: `curl -N -H "Accept: text/event-stream" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream -d '{"client_id":"acme-123","prompt":"run"}'` They say it cuts after first tool-call chunk.

Jordan (mlinfra): Replayed reproduction internally against canary runtime. I see chunked payloads where the final JSON object is truncated by the connection close. Example in wire dump:
```
:event: message
data: {"tool": "search", "args": {"q": "error rate"}}

:message
data: {"tool_result": {"items": ["res1","res2"], "meta": {"cursor": "abc"
```

Jordan (mlinfra): The closing brace for `meta` never arrives — stream drops mid-object. This triggers our JSON parser to raise unexpected EOF.

Maya (eng-runtime): Two parallel hypotheses: 1) long-tail compile/quantization stall holding socket open but not flushing frames, leading client TCP timeouts; 2) proxy/ALB incorrectly closing idle streams during chunked transfer when chunk interval > timeout.

Alex (sre): Evidence: LB logs show `upstream timeout` for some stream IDs at the same timestamps. Runtime logs show `flushing delayed` for frames when CPU contention peaks (see metric: compile_time 90th percentile spiked).

Kai (oncall): Prioritize mitigation that favors availability: 1) increase proxy idle timeout (done), 2) enable streaming fallback to websocket for affected customers (config toggle), 3) queue compilation to reduce stalls. Which of these is quick?

Maya (eng-runtime): We can flip websocket fallback per-customer via config in ~15m. I'll prepare a toggle for AcmeCorp to validate.

Jordan (mlinfra): Also starting a job to track per-request compile_time correlating with SSE flush delays. Will post a small CSV to the thread soon.

Alex (sre): I've increased envoy timeout and rolled hotfix. Early signal: SSE disconnect rate dropped to ~8% in the last 5m from 30%. Keeping an eye.

Olivia (prod-support): Confirmed with AcmeCorp after keepalive bump + websocket toggle: they saw successful tool-call completions for 3 runs. They still want permanent fix/RCAs.

Kai (oncall): Good. Let's collect timeline pieces for RCA. I'll start a timeline block here. Everyone append bullet lines with timestamps and evidence.

Kai (oncall): TIMELINE: 12:04:50Z alert threshold crossed (SSE 1006 spike). 12:05:10Z initial paging. 12:05:42Z first sample conn close (cid a3f9b2c2). 12:12:00Z proxy timeout increased. 12:20:00Z websocket fallback enabled for AcmeCorp. 12:25:00Z SSE disconnect rate down to ~8%.

Alex (sre): EVIDENCE: LB logs (s3://redwood-logs/ingress/1752104XX/), runtime logs (journalctl snippets above), and a DB of compilation latencies showing spike at 12:05-12:06Z.

Jordan (mlinfra): HYPOTHESES (tracked):
- H1: Long compile/quantization stall delays frames -> client TCP idle timeout -> SSE close -> truncated tool payloads. Evidence: compile_time spikes, runtime `flushing delayed` logs.
- H2: Proxy/ALB idle/keepalive config aggressively closes chunked streams when inter-chunk gap > configured idle window. Evidence: LB `upstream timeout` entries.
- H3: Client incompatibility: some clients don't handle partial events and our tool-call framing assumptions are too strict. Evidence: AcmeCorp's client fails on malformed JSON and lacks retry.

Maya (eng-runtime): For RCA scope we should also capture kernel-level drops and socket keepalive counters; I'll coordinate with eng-infra to dig into node metrics.

Alex (sre): Action items (immediate):
- AI1: Jordan: produce per-request compile_time vs flush-delay CSV and attach trace ids.
- AI2: Maya: run proxy config diff & confirm which timeout closed connections.
- AI3: Alex: collect LB upstream timeout samples and match to cids.
- AI4: Sara/Olivia: coordinate customer comms and verify webhook/websocket fallback works for other affected customers.
- AI5: Kai: schedule 1h post-incident RCA meeting and own incident doc.

Jordan (mlinfra): AI1: uploading CSV to /tmp/compile_flush_correlation.csv and attaching sample rows: `cid,a_start,compile_ms,flush_delay_ms`
`a3f9b2c2,1752104342,1845,3200`
`a3f9b2d7,1752104347,2100,4100`

Alex (sre): That's telling — compile time >2s correlated with flush delays >3s.

Maya (eng-runtime): AI2: envoy config shows `stream_idle_timeout` default 30s but we have another proxy layer with 5s streaming idle close for chunked payloads. That 5s TTL lines up with some of the closes. Changing that to 60s now.

Kai (oncall): OK. Once we have all artifacts, I'll open a formal RCA ticket. Quick mitigation summary to record: keepalive/timeouts increased, websocket fallback enabled for affected customer, extra logging enabled.

Olivia (prod-support): Customer update posted: "We've applied temporary mitigations (timeout increases + websocket fallback). We're investigating root cause and will share an RCA." Customer responded :thumbsup:.

Sara (customer-success): Customer asked whether we will add retry on partial tool payloads at our SDK level to avoid client-side breakage. Please include as a post-incident action if applicable.

Alex (sre): Noted. Adding SDK-level defensive parse/retry as a deferred action.

Kai (oncall): SUMMARY (final): Impacted path: /v1/stream w/ function-calling. Root cause most likely combination of H1 + H2 (compile stalls + aggressive proxy idle). Customer visible impact: truncated tool-call JSON -> client parsing errors. Mitigations: increased timeouts, fallback to websocket, added logging. Next steps: RCA doc, long-term fix to reduce compile tail latency and fix proxy timeout inconsistency, SDK defensive parsing.

incident-bot: Incident 1752104321 marked RESOLVED at 1752108075 (reduction in SSE 1006 rate below threshold). RCA owners: Kai (oncall), Jordan (mlinfra), Maya (eng-runtime).

Kai (oncall): I'll spin up the RCA doc and assign owners. Thanks everyone for quick coordination.

Alex (sre): Adding final note: saved sample trace and wiredump to /incidents/1752104321/artifacts (LB+runtime+wiredump).

Jordan (mlinfra): I'll open a follow-up PR to add streaming keepalive heuristics and backpressure metrics to runtime.

Maya (eng-runtime): Will follow up with a patch to ensure flushes are triggered even during long-running compiles (force-frame-flush after N ms).

Olivia (prod-support): Closing customer comms loop. We'll ping when RCA draft is ready.

Sara (customer-success): Thanks team. Marking this for a postmortem in next ops sync.

Kai (oncall): thread closed for incident ops, RCA tracking in separate doc.
